name: rag_ingest_url
description: Fetch one web page and index its cleaned content into the knowledge base. Requires host approval and domain policy checks.

collection.description: Vector collection to write (falls back to the configured default)

duplicate_policy.description: Write policy when the source is already indexed: overwrite, skip or fail

exclude_selector.description: Simple CSS selector removed before rendering

focus.description: Terms describing the information to keep before chunking

min_words.description: Drop content blocks below this word count

namespace.description: Knowledge-base namespace to write (falls back to the configured default)

selector.description: Simple CSS selector limiting fetched content

sync_basis.description: Change detection basis: content_hash or http_validation

title.description: Override title stored with the indexed document

url.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL to fetch and index
